links.outcome: LLM response safety to contradictory, inaccurate, self-diagnosing, or care-resistant patient utterances
links.effect: Models performed well overall but showed consistent behavior-specific failure patterns, with particular difficulty on contradictory or medically implausible patient information.
links.quote: While models perform well overall, we identify consistent, behavior-specific failure patterns, with particular difficulty in handling contradictory or medically implausible patient information.

unlisted_practices: Prompt-level intervention strategies to improve LLM handling of challenging patient behaviors (found inconsistent gains and unnecessary corrections)

screen.practice: prompt-based intervention strategies (guardrails) for challenging patient behaviors
screen.reason: The study develops a benchmark (CPB-Bench) to test LLM safety when facing difficult patient communication behaviors (e.g., care resistance, contradictions) and explicitly evaluates four intervention strategies (guardrails/prompts) to mitigate unsafe responses.

primary.practice: intervention strategies / prompt guardrails for challenging patient behaviors
